pages.text: This book covers what lies above Akaishi Energy — $(reset)Life Energy$(reset) — and the body research and modification it unlocks.$(br2)$(bold)Main line in one phrase:$(reset) Akaishi Energy → Life Energy → Samples → Genes → Organs → Transplant & Mutate.$(br2)$(bold)Before you start:$(reset) Life Energy is converted from Akaishi Energy, so first build a $(reset)stable power grid$(reset) (generation, storage, pipes) as covered in the Energy chapter of the Akaishi Research Diary.$(br2)Blue text is clickable, and entry numbers within a chapter are the suggested reading order. Each stage below follows the same pattern: $(bold)what to build, why, and what to read next$(reset).

pages.title: Stage 1 - Generate: Refining Life Energy
pages.text: $(bold)What to build first:$(reset) assemble the $(l:akaishi:life_conversion)Life Conversion Matrix$(/l) to turn oceans of Akaishi Energy into Life Energy, then craft a $(l:akaishi:life_energy)Life Energy Cell$(/l) and Life Energy Pipes to store and deliver it.$(br2)$(bold)Why:$(reset) the Matrix is the life line's $(reset)only Life Energy source$(reset) — every machine downstream depends on it, so unstable generation stops the whole chain.$(br2)$(bold)Next:$(reset) liquid energy is difficult to trade. In Stage 2 it is solidified into a currency.

pages.title: Stage 2 - Solidify: Turning Energy into Currency
pages.text: $(bold)What to build first:$(reset) the $(l:akaishi:life_purifier)Life Energy Purifier$(/l), which condenses flowing Life Energy into $(reset)Life Essence Solids$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Why:$(reset) the Solid is the life line's $(reset)universal currency$(reset) — organ crafting, transplants, cultivation and brewing all charge it. It can be carried, hoarded and piped far more easily than raw energy.$(br2)$(bold)Next:$(reset) with currency in hand, move to Stage 3, which begins with sample collection.

pages.title: Stage 3 - Samples → Genes → Organs
pages.text: $(bold)What to build first:$(reset) follow $(l:akaishi:life_samples)Samples & Genes$(/l) to collect samples and crack out gene sequences, then $(l:akaishi:life_organs)Organ Construction$(/l) for forging and transplanting organs; $(l:akaishi:life_potions)Potions$(/l) absorb genotypes and grant temporary bursts.$(br2)$(bold)Why:$(reset) organs provide the main combat power; monitor rejection, as hostile combinations trigger backlash.$(br2)$(bold)Next:$(reset) Stage 4 raises the caps of basic organs with mutation traits.

pages.title: Stages 4 & 5 - Mutation & Advanced Life
pages.text: $(bold)What to build first:$(reset) roll random traits onto organs in the Life Breeder — see $(l:akaishi:trait_safe)Safe Mutations$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:trait_dual)Aberrant Double-Edged$(/l) codexes, and the $(l:akaishi:trait_reforger)Trait Reforger$(/l) for rerolling.$(br2)$(bold)Advanced:$(reset) body scanning and decay cleanup live in $(l:akaishi:life_body)Body & Decay$(/l), exhausted-fuel recycling in $(l:akaishi:life_waste)Waste Neutralization$(/l); the endgame is the fusion ingots of the $(l:akaishi:mother_altar)Altar of the Black Mother$(/l), forged into endgame armor on the $(l:akaishi:life_fusion_anvil)Life Fusion Anvil$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Why:$(reset) both stages consume large amounts of resources; establish a resource base first.
Reading order: establish Life Energy production, bank it as solids, then start from samples and read through the organ line.
